name: Miu
source:
“Just as I thought, you really were exactly the kind of person I believed you were.”

She is a girl who brightens her surroundings with a gentle, warm atmosphere simply by being there. With her easygoing personality, she even has the peculiar “talent” of tripping over nothing at all. Although she wishes to be independent, she naturally stirs protective instincts in those around her, and people often find themselves taking care of her. Because of her kindness, she tends to carry her worries alone.
